build.script:
#!/bin/sh

# Build Image
docker build -t aliasproject/php:8.1-fpm php/8.1/fpm

# Tag Image
docker tag aliasproject/php:8.1-fpm ghcr.io/aliasproject/php:8.1-fpm

# Build multiple architectures and push
docker buildx build --platform linux/arm64/v8,linux/amd64 --push -t ghcr.io/aliasproject/php:8.1-fpm php/8.1/fpm
